title: Affection
summary: Affection is showing warmth and care — hugs, holding hands, kind words, small gestures. Everyone has different preferences for how much and what kind.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
